evidence.title: spacering-net/codeg repository
evidence.finding: Main repository: 4,498 stars on 2026-11-16, Apache-2.0 per GitHub, default branch main, not archived; formerly xintaofei/codeg.

evidence.title: Codeg README at v0.45.0
evidence.finding: Multi-agent coding workspace over ACP with twenty built-in agents, sessions import, delegation, to-dos in worktrees, automations, desktop/server/Docker/mobile, chat channels, codeg-cli and Apache-2.0 license.

evidence.title: Apache License 2.0 file
evidence.finding: Repository license is Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: Repository AGENTS.md
evidence.finding: Tauri 2 desktop (Rust), standalone Axum codeg-server, codeg-mcp stdio companion for async sub-agent delegation, Next.js static frontend, SeaORM and SQLite.

evidence.title: Download and install
evidence.locator: Desktop app, Mobile apps, system requirements
evidence.finding: Desktop installers for macOS (Apple Silicon, Intel), Windows x64 and Arm64, Linux x64 and arm64; iOS 26+ App Store client and Android 12+ APK in testing; mobile apps are clients of a user Codeg host; agent CLIs needed; delegation bundled.

evidence.title: Deployment
evidence.locator: Install script, Docker, HTTPS and token notes
evidence.finding: codeg-server via install script or Docker, plain HTTP behind a TLS reverse proxy, token auth; signed forge webhooks accepted.

evidence.title: Configuration
evidence.finding: CODEG_TOKEN, CODEG_AUTH=proxy-jwt for identity-aware proxies, CODEG_HOST and bridge settings.

evidence.title: Authentication and models
evidence.finding: Codeg ships no model; each agent uses its own subscription login, a provider API key or compatible endpoint, or a saved Model Provider for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini.

evidence.title: Working with agents
evidence.finding: Per-agent settings; Codeg serves file and terminal operations itself unless disabled; it adds no sandbox of its own.

evidence.title: Supported agents
evidence.finding: Twenty built-in ACP agents plus any ACP agent via registry or JSON.

evidence.title: To-dos
evidence.locator: pipeline, concurrency limit, review, retry, delivery
evidence.finding: To-do board with pipeline to do, queued, setting up, running, awaiting input, to review, merging, done; one worktree per task; per-folder concurrency default 2; init command; scheduled and automatic start; review gate before merge; task_progress and task_complete tools; restarts mark runs failed with retry from the recorded branch.

evidence.title: Multi-agent collaboration
evidence.locator: How delegation works; Watch the team work
evidence.finding: Lead agent delegates sub-tasks to other agents via the codeg-mcp companion over ACP; non-blocking hand-offs, depth setting (default 1, max 8), live sub-agent viewing, @ mentions, assistants; ships off until enabled.

evidence.title: Automations
evidence.finding: Cron or on-demand headless agent runs saved as conversations; one run at a time per automation (later ones recorded Skipped); Enqueue task runs write a to-do.

evidence.title: Repository panel
evidence.finding: Lists GitHub, GitLab, Gitea/Forgejo and CNB issues and pull requests; an item becomes a to-do with provenance; comment, open/close issues and merge in-app; scheduled scan and webhooks.

evidence.title: Git and worktrees
evidence.finding: Commit window, pull/fetch/push, stash, rollback, three-pane merge editor, image diffs and worktree management.

evidence.title: Token usage
evidence.finding: Per-turn token rows read from each agent transcript, charts by folder, agent, model and session, and a labelled list-price estimate that is not the bill.

evidence.title: MCP servers
evidence.finding: Local MCP scan, registry search and install of MCP servers for the agents Codeg drives.

evidence.title: Skills
evidence.finding: Skill packs per agent, expert skills and research skills available to any agent.

evidence.title: Conversation aggregation
evidence.finding: Imports each agent history from disk into one searchable workspace and lets the original agent continue it.

evidence.title: Conversations
evidence.finding: Rich chat with queue or mid-turn steer, cancel, permission and question cards, context ring, fork, plan checklist.

evidence.title: Chat channels
evidence.finding: Run tasks, talk to agents and approve permission prompts from Telegram, Lark or WeChat.

evidence.title: Privacy and security
evidence.finding: No analytics, telemetry or tracking of any kind and no Codeg account; network used only for user-initiated actions plus update checks about every six hours; agents have their own telemetry habits.

evidence.title: Workspace
evidence.finding: Editor, live diffs, terminals, split views, desktop Web Service tower icon, remote workspaces on desktop.
